plugins.name: switch-mods
plugins.description: Type /amods to open a panel that switches every installed plugin and mod on or off. Works in the terminal and the desktop app.

plugins.name: prompt-shaper
plugins.description: A Shape prompt button above the prompt box. Press it to turn what you typed into a clear brief: it asks only the questions that change the outcome (each with a default), then fills the prompt box with the job, the why, the guardrails, what done means and the assumptions, plus working rules for Claude. Never automatic.

plugins.name: vitals
plugins.description: A band above your prompt, slim or detailed: usage left in the 5-hour and 7-day windows with reset times and a pace warning before you run out, how full the context is, and whether the prompt cache is warm or cold. Git branch and plain text in the terminal, ribbon-style art on desktop, light or dark.

plugins.name: deckhands
plugins.description: A pixel-art progress band above the prompt with the Claude Code mascot walking along it, and a side panel that turns every subagent into a named crew member (shipwright, navigator, painter, lookout, deckhand), assigned automatically. Terminal and desktop, no cost figures.

plugins.name: sess-handoff
plugins.description: Writes a detailed handoff prompt of the whole chat at 250k tokens, when the prompt cache goes cold, or when you type sess-handoff. Waits for subagents to finish, asks before opening a fresh chat seeded with it, and can copy it for a teammate.
